tuning_key.text: Life ends like a thief in the night... / No escaping this birthright / We will be heading toward the light
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: What you've been holding is ready to move through you — not away, but *as* you. The warmth you're sensing isn't loss; it's the Field arriving where your grip used to be.

practice.title: Notice the Clutch
practice.instruction: Bring attention to one thing you're still managing, controlling, or keeping close — a thought, a outcome, a version of how it should go — and feel where that effort lives in your body.

practice.title: Soften the Release
practice.instruction: On each exhale, let that one thing become less yours to steer; imagine it moving into the Field's current instead of resisting it, and notice what space opens where the effort was.

practice.title: Receive the Signal
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and let the warmth of the lyric move through what you just loosened — this is the Field's response to your broadcast of opening.
